tasks.dev: deno task build && deno run --allow-net --allow-read jsr:@std/http@1/file-server --port 8131 dist
tasks.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/deseret && cp web/index.html web/site.css web/favicon.png web/icon-512.png web/apple-touch-icon.png data/cmudict.dict dist/ && cp web/deseret/index.html web/deseret/og.png dist/deseret/ && deno bundle --platform browser --minify -o dist/deseret/app.js web/app.ts
tasks.check: deno fmt --check && deno lint && deno check
